test_grpc_status_ok: test the StatusTest class to verify successful RPC calls return None status
test_grpc_status_not_ok: test the StatusTest class to verify failed RPC calls return INTERNAL status code
test_error_details_unpacking: test extracting and unpacking DebugInfo error details from a gRPC RpcError status
test_code_message_validation: test that inconsistent trailing metadata raises a ValueError during status extraction
test_invalid_status_code: test that an invalid status code like 42 raises an Unknown error with details
